privacyExportDescription: Download a JSON copy of your profile, consent record, submitted questionnaires, and saved risk assessments. The export is limited to your account and is not stored separately by the app.
privacyExportEmpty: Your export was downloaded. You have no saved questionnaire or risk assessment records yet.
privacyExportError: We could not export your data. Check your connection and try again.
privacyRetentionDescription: The app does not currently publish an automatic retention period or provide self-service deletion. Contact your app administrator to ask about deleting your account data. Downloaded export files are stored on your device and are not deleted by the app.
privacyConsentGranted: Health data consent is currently recorded for your account.
privacyConsentNotGranted: Health data consent is not currently recorded for your account.
privacyConsentDescription: Health features require current consent. Consent cannot currently be withdrawn from settings; contact your app administrator with questions. Optional marketing consent is separate from health-feature consent.
healthDesc: Take our comprehensive health questionnaire to get personalized insights.
prescriptionDesc: Keep track of your medications and get reminders.
getSupportDesc: Connect with healthcare professionals for personalized support.
introSubtitle: A multilingual preventive health platform designed to make health insights accessible, understandable, and personalized for everyone.
introDescription: The Health App helps you assess your health risks, understand key factors affecting your well-being, and receive personalized recommendations — all in your preferred language. Our platform combines modern technology with a user-friendly experience to support better health decisions.
introHighlight4: Real-time insights powered by intelligent systems
